name: Yuichi Hiyama
source: Yuichi Hiyama is the star of the school's soccer team and is tipped for great things in the future. Yuichi and Aya become fast friends over their shared love of beef bowls. However as tryout season approaches, Yuichi comes to Aya with an offer she may not be able to pass up...
